name: Residential rooftop solar in Delhi (PM Surya Ghar route)
verified_by: Aroha team (AI-assisted reading of the official EEREM Delhi page, last updated 13 Oct 2026); to be confirmed by a team member

steps.title: Register on the national rooftop solar portal (pmsuryaghar.gov.in).
Log in and submit the rooftop solar application.
The DISCOM checks technical feasibility and emails its approval.
Hire a registered vendor to install the system; share the system details with the DISCOM.
After installation, submit the documents to the DISCOM and the national portal.
The DISCOM inspects the plant and approves it if it meets the technical standards.
The DISCOM installs the net meter and solar meter; the system can then be switched on.
The DISCOM updates the meter details on the portal, which issues the commissioning certificate.
Submit bank details and a cancelled cheque on the portal for the central subsidy (paid within 30 days of verification).
Share bank details with the DISCOM for the Delhi capital subsidy and generation incentive (credited from the first bill after the net meter).

documents.label: Latest electricity bill (shows your CA / consumer number)
Proof of ownership or permission to use the roof
Bank account details and a cancelled cheque

lessons.text: Delhi rooftop solar: the state capital subsidy and the generation-based incentive are paid by the DISCOM against the first electricity bill after the net meter is installed, so share bank details with the DISCOM (source: EEREM Delhi, https://eerem.delhi.gov.in/hi/node/12632, checked 1 Nov 2026).
